title: Geometric Twins: Congruence
summary: When are two triangles exactly the same? The SSS, SAS, ASA and RHS tests, and why AAA and SSA fail.

cbse.chapter: Ganita Prakash Part 2 Ch 1: Geometric Twins

objectives: I can use the SSS, SAS, ASA/AAS and RHS tests for congruence.
I can explain why AAA and SSA are not enough.
I can use congruence to find missing sides and angles.
misconceptions: Triangles with equal angles are always congruent.
Any three equal measurements prove congruence.
Congruent triangles must face the same way.
